publicInputs.name: domainHash
publicInputs.semantics: Most-significant 248 bits of SHA-256 over a versioned, length-delimited encoding of runtime global_id, workchain, current contract address, application domain, circuit ID, VK hash, protocol, action/opcode and version
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Read global_id from TVM config 19, serialize every field canonically, hash once, take the first 31 bytes big-endian, and require exact equality

publicInputs.name: senderHashHigh128
publicInputs.semantics: High 128 bits of the canonical 256-bit TON address cell hash for the authorized sender
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Hash the canonical sender address cell, split the big-endian digest into two 128-bit limbs, and compare this high limb

publicInputs.name: senderHashLow128
publicInputs.semantics: Low 128 bits of the canonical 256-bit TON address cell hash for the authorized sender
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Hash the canonical sender address cell, split the big-endian digest into two 128-bit limbs, and compare this low limb

publicInputs.name: recipientHashHigh128
publicInputs.semantics: High 128 bits of the canonical 256-bit TON address cell hash for the recipient
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Hash the canonical recipient address cell, split the big-endian digest into two 128-bit limbs, and compare this high limb

publicInputs.name: recipientHashLow128
publicInputs.semantics: Low 128 bits of the canonical 256-bit TON address cell hash for the recipient
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Hash the canonical recipient address cell, split the big-endian digest into two 128-bit limbs, and compare this low limb

publicInputs.name: amount
publicInputs.semantics: Transfer amount in token base units
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Compare with the exact state delta and enforce 1 <= amount < 2^64

publicInputs.name: stateRoot
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Compare with currentRoot in contract storage

publicInputs.name: nullifier
publicInputs.semantics: One-time identifier derived from the spent note secret and domain
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Require absent in usedNullifiers and insert after successful verification

publicInputs.name: validUntil
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Require blockchain.now() <= validUntil and bounded future validity

publicInputs.name: assetIdHigh128
publicInputs.semantics: High 128 bits of the canonical 256-bit asset cell hash
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Hash the canonical asset cell, split the big-endian digest into two 128-bit limbs, and compare this high limb

publicInputs.name: assetIdLow128
publicInputs.semantics: Low 128 bits of the canonical 256-bit asset cell hash
publicInputs.applicationCheck: Hash the canonical asset cell, split the big-endian digest into two 128-bit limbs, and compare this low limb
